Designated as Patthana 1.23, it forms one of the triad (*tika*) expositions of the conditional relations system, treating phenomena classified in terms of visibility and sensory impingement / resistance [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral lists one translation of the text in one modern language [SuttaCentral].
